eps.ov: Satou Takahiro awakens to find himself in a universe identical to his favorite sci-fi game.
After landing on the trade colony Tarmein Prime, Hiro rescues an orphan named Mimi.
The space force demands that Elma pay for the damage she caused during the previous battle.
Hiro's crew take a break to go shopping and acquire some critical data after defeating some suspicious ships.
Against a massive fleet, Hiro and his crew go on a reckless giant-killing mission.
Hiro and his crew undergo a medical examination by Shouko, an inquisitive doctor.
Just as Hiro's crew is about to leave on vacation, they receive a distress call from the local port authority.
After a battle against space pirates, Hiro's crew recover a cold-sleep pod from the floating wreckage.
